title: Name steps clearly
summary: Step names appear in the run log. Clear names help someone find the part that failed.
introduction: Step names appear in the run log. Clear names help someone find the part that failed. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Step names appear in the run log. Clear names help someone find the part that failed.

blocks.code:
steps:
  - name: Show working directory
    run: pwd
  - name: Print learning message
    run: echo "Read the result"
blocks.title: Name steps clearly

blocks.text: The log groups each command under a useful name.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Write a name for a step that checks formatting.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A step name should describe its action, not claim it passed.
For more detail later, use this [GitHub Actions further reading](https://docs.github.com/en/actions).
